    AI Overview
    Yes,
    Director Leon Vance (played by Rocky Carroll) left NCIS in the 500th episode, which aired on March 24, 2026    . Vance was killed in a, "shocking" storyline where he died from wounds sustained during a shooting, marking his departure after 18 seasons. Carroll's final appearance, filmed in December 2025, involved a, surreal, goodbye scene with a young version of Dr. Donald "Ducky" Mallard. 
    Key details: 
    • The Exit: The 500th episode (Season 23, Episode 13) featured the death of Director Vance, who was killed by a corrupt agent while protecting the agency, according to MARCA and Screen Rant.
    • Actor’s Perspective: Rocky Carroll, who has played the role since 2008, stated it was "not my choice" to leave, as the producers wanted a dramatic, high-impact moment for the milestone episode, as reported by Us Weekly and Variety.
    • Long-term Planning: The producers had considered killing off the character for over a decade, but finally went through with it for the 500th episode to create lasting, "shockwaves" in the series, explains Variety and Deadline. 
    Vance's death closes a major chapter for the show, ending a 16-year run for the character as a central, stabilizing figure, as discussed in Screen Rant.
